title: D P D and five fluorouracil, U G T one A one and irinotecan

segs.text: Section thirteen. Two cancer drug examples: D P D with five fluorouracil, and U G T one A one with irinotecan. D P D is the main breakdown route that keeps five fluorouracil in check. U G T one A one clears a toxic active metabolite of a drug that is already active. In both, a low activity variant can cause severe bone marrow suppression.

D P D, dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase, is coded by the D P Y D gene and handles the antimetabolites five fluorouracil, capecitabine and tegafur. About eighty percent of a five fluorouracil dose is normally broken down by D P D to non toxic products. A low activity variant sends more drug toward the active cytotoxic metabolite. The worst result is myelosuppression, bone marrow suppression, which can be lethal; mucositis, neurotoxicity, hand foot syndrome and diarrhea also occur. These variants are not yet well characterized.

Irinotecan is not a prodrug. It is already active, and it is further metabolized to an active metabolite, S N thirty eight, which U G T one A one clears. A carrier of U G T one A one star twenty eight makes less enzyme, so less glucuronidation, the reaction that clears S N thirty eight, takes place, and S N thirty eight builds up to toxic levels. The Katzung chapter calls irinotecan a prodrug; she teaches that it is already active.

Compare U G T one A one star twenty eight with C Y P two C nineteen star seventeen. Both are in the promoter region, where the machinery that expresses the gene starts. Star twenty eight decreases expression; star seventeen increases it. A promoter variant can push expression either way, so each one's direction has to be known.
